newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UBS wants to expand asset management.
newsitem.headline: UBS wants to expand asset management.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it wants to focus efforts on expansion of its asset management business and in this regard, an acquisition cannot be ruled out.

"We want to focus our efforts particularly on the expansion of our asset management business both at home and abroad," UBS Mathis Cabiallavetta said in a speech prepared for a news conference to present UBS's results.

He said UBS already held an excellent position in this business, particularly in Switzerland, and wanted to use this as a platform to "aggressively" build up its capabilities abroad. "Obviously, an acquisition is a step that cannot be ruled out entirely," he said.

"We will not expand our activities across the board with a view to becoming a global and traditional investment bank, but will adopt a more selective approach to expansion," he said in comments about the bank group's new strategic focus.
